visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a woman with short brown hair, wearing a striped turtleneck and a black sweatshirt. She stands against a plain beige wall, smiling warmly and holding her hands together. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. (2) A quick cut reveals three young children—two boys and a girl—sitting on a gray couch in a living room environment. One boy is lying down while the others look at objects in their hands. The background is a simple white wall. (3) The camera cuts back to the woman in the original studio setting. She uses active hand gestures, waving and pointing to emphasize her speech, while maintaining direct eye contact with the lens. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (4) The scene shifts to the woman in a small, cluttered storage room. She is wearing a white hoodie and sitting in front of a professional condenser microphone mounted on a boom arm. Behind her are shelves filled with household items, boxes, and a printer. (5) Returning to the beige studio background, the woman puts her hands to her throat, miming a raspy voice with a pained expression. Brightly colored variety-show style text bubbles appear briefly around her. (6) A large, stylized red and white bird mascot is shown in a spacious white room, dancing alongside three young girls. The room is decorated with a projection screen and festive lighting. (7) Back in the studio, the woman smiles and listens, touching her ear. Animated graphics of a parrot and text bubbles with the date '2026' appear as overlays above her head. (8) A screen capture of a BBC news report and a mobile app interface are displayed as floating windows next to the woman while she continues to talk. (9) The video concludes with a full-screen graphic card featuring the red bird mascot, balloons, and promotional text regarding a website launch and limited-time offers against a festive yellow background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 從兩年前到現在. [Subtitle]: 我錄製小知識. [Subtitle]: 竟然默默滿1000集了. (2) [Subtitle]: 很多家長都會問我說. (3) [Subtitle]: 有3個小孩到底要怎麼錄音呢. (4) [Subtitle]: 其實啊在還沒有辦公室之前呢. (5) [Subtitle]: 我都是先把小孩哄睡之後. [Subtitle]: 再跑去儲藏室錄音. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以大家聽到很多作品呢. [Subtitle]: 都是半夜完成的喲. (7) [Subtitle]: 要維持週一到週五都有小知識的日更. [Subtitle]: 其實還蠻不容易的. (8) [Subtitle]: 還記得啊疫情期間我喉嚨沙啞失聲. (9) [Subtitle]: 好險那個時候有我們的代班DJ派派. [Subtitle]: 來幫我救火. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們才能夠日更不間斷. (11) [Subtitle]: 也偷偷跟大家預告一個好消息. (12) [Subtitle]: 2026年派派即將要回來囉. (13) [Subtitle]: 除了全新一季的派派故事. [Subtitle]: 小知識也會有新的改版內容唷. (14) [Subtitle]: 未來每週四我會分享一些國際新聞. (15) [Subtitle]: 希望從小培養孩子與世界接軌的能力. (16) [Subtitle]: 最後呢想跟爸爸媽媽說. [Subtitle]: 保持對世界的好奇心. [Subtitle]: 就是我們送給孩子最棒的禮物. (17) [Subtitle]: 鼓勵你們家孩子也可以把他們觀察到的問題投稿給我. (18) [Logo]: 媽爹小知識 小耳朵投稿專區. (19) [Slogan]: 限時暖房優惠 12/1-1/6 小耳朵回家囉! 官網新家落成!
